incident-bot: PAGER: billing-metering ALERT — token-count drift > 12% for prod-emitter across eu-west-1 window (10m)
kira: acked, oncall here. pulling recent ingest metrics and kafka offsets now.
sam: on it too. initial check: emitter backlog spike around 17:04 UTC, downstream aggregator shows ~10-15m delay
alex: are customers getting overage flags? any automated emails triggered?
csm-elena: yes — we’ve seen 4 customers report overage notices starting ~17:20. I'm pausing notification workflow now (sent to support). :grimacing:
mike: running quick SQL to compare token tallies vs shadow counts
mike: ```sql
SELECT window_start, sum(tokens_emitted) as emitted, sum(tokens_processed) as processed
FROM billing.emitter_windows
WHERE window_start >= '2026-03-18T16:45:00Z'
GROUP BY window_start
ORDER BY window_start;
```
mike: results show a persistent gap (~14% deficit) on processed side after 17:02 UTC
kira: looks like a delayed consumer commit — offsets high but processed lagging. checking consumer group lags: `kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group billing-processor`
sam: I see repeated retry errors in billing-processor logs: `CommitFailedException` then a surge of rebalances around 17:03
alex: that explains token counting drift (emitter produced but processor didn't finish commits). we should mute the overage alerting rule while we triage to avoid noise
kira: agreed. @incident-bot please suppress rule billing.overages.email for 30m
incident-bot: Suppression created: billing.overages.email (30m) by kira
billing-eng: quick note — we deployed a consumer-side change yesterday that added acks=all on the local emitter; might be related. rolling back is an option but we need safe rollback plan
mike: backfill plan: once consumer catchup completes we can run `billing.reconcile_windows(v=17:00-17:30)` to reaggregate processed tokens and correct flags
sam: timeline: detecting root cause and pushing mitigation now. If consumer doesn't catch up within 15m, we'll throttle emitter producers to avoid further drift and hold notifications
csm-elena: telling support to freeze outgoing billing messages and to notify affected customers that we’re investigating — draft message ready if needed
alex: owner for mitigation + postmortem? assigning to @kira for live mitigation, @billing-eng for rollback decision, @mike for reconciliation script
kira: handing off to night oncall in 20m — @sam will take live after me. sam, you have the handover context.
sam: copy. I'll monitor consumer lag, coord with billing-eng for rollback, and run the reconcile backfill when safe. will post updates here every 10m. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Pager acknowledged by kira. Severity: P2. Channel: #incidents. Tags: billing,metering,customer-impact
kira: quick note — created ticket BU-4923 (metering: consumer commit failures -> token drift). linking logs and kafka offsets
mike: posting short checklist for whoever takes over:
- mute overage notifications (done)
- check kafka consumer group lags
- inspect recent deploys (billing-processor) and revert if confirmed
- run reconcile backfill after catchup
- coordinate customer comms with csm
sam: update 1 (17:30): consumer lag decreasing, commits succeeding intermittently, no new overage notices after suppression. continuing to watch.
sam: update 2 (17:45): processed counts converging, reconcile queued, will run in 10m. transferring ownership: @sam now oncall for incident
csm-elena: will draft customer follow-up post-reconciliation with timestamped adjustments
billing-eng: once reconcile completes, we'll validate and trigger a safe un-suppress of notification rules. expect final reconciliation job to finish by ~18:05 UTC
kira: handing off - leaving notes in BU-4923. good work team. :heart:
sam: closing updates here once reconciliation verified and we re-enable alerts.
